entities.name: Query Ham1p-like protein
observations: 203 aa protein; calculated molecular weight 22.08 kDa and theoretical pI 5.39.
Contains a Ham1p_like Pfam domain (PF01725.22) spanning residues 9–198.
Shows 72.8% identity over 99.5% query coverage to reviewed Ruegeria pomeroyi dITP/XTP pyrophosphatase Q5LWF7; additional reviewed homologs show 55–57% identity over approximately 95–98% coverage.
Likely bacterial cytosolic homodimeric dITP/XTP pyrophosphatase based on conserved homolog annotations; exact oligomerization and localization are inferred, not directly measured for this sequence.

entities.name: Q5LWF7
observations: Reviewed Ruegeria pomeroyi dITP/XTP pyrophosphatase; EC 3.6.1.66.
Hydrolyzes XTP, dITP, and ITP to the corresponding monophosphate plus diphosphate; binds one Mg2+ per subunit and forms a homodimer.

entities.name: Noncanonical purine NTP hydrolysis
observations: Representative reactions are XTP + H2O → XMP + diphosphate, dITP + H2O → dIMP + diphosphate, and ITP + H2O → IMP + diphosphate; corresponding Rhea references are RHEA:28610, RHEA:28342, and RHEA:29399.

entities.name: Magnesium cofactor
observations: Curated homologs are annotated to bind one Mg2+ ion per subunit; cofactor assignment is transferred by strong homology and is not directly experimentally established for the query sequence.
